svg.title: 32_smsystem datapipe and database flow
svg.desc: Two workflows: startup backfill writes raw daily and intraday bars to Postgres and derives ATR + RVOL baselines; runtime streams incoming 2-minute bars into the livestream table via either the live WebSocket consumer or the replay driver.
svg.text: green = external source · blue = datapipe · cylinder = Postgres table · dashed red = read
1 · BACKFILL — historian, once per trading day
